idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After rollback: service healthy, error rate ~0.2%. Follow-up needed: root-cause v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** The broken release, v2.3.1, was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west with an 18% error rate. All three regions are now on v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. A status check afterwards showed the service healthy with an error rate of about 0.2%. The release candidate for v2.3.1 had also failed health checks in staging.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-up: find the root cause of v2.3.1's failure before deploying it again. My first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that nothing had been created, then retried with the same idempotency key (an ID that stops a retry from creating a second incident), so only one incident exists.
